# Plan: Verify and release Day 0

## Sources

`tests/e2e/fixtures.ts`, `tests/e2e/helpers.ts`, `playwright.config.ts`, `.github/workflows/pages.yml`, `src/render/loop.ts`. Existing docs: `docs/game-design.md`, `docs/content-authoring.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`. `AGENTS.md` is SwarmOS-generated, and this WorkUnit sets `allow_harness_changes`.

## Tests

- `tests/e2e/journey.spec.ts`: from the opening to the post-episode map, through the real UI. Runs in two configurations using `test.describe` with `test.use({ reducedMotion })`: normal and `reduce`. In reduced motion it also asserts `data-motion=off`.
- `tests/e2e/fixtures.ts`: when `SIGNAL_LOST_LIVE=1`, requests are not intercepted, so the same specs can run against the deployed site. This is how post-merge verification runs: `SIGNAL_LOST_LIVE=1 npx playwright test journey`.
- `tests/e2e/startup.spec.ts`: application startup has no failed requests and no console errors under the subpath. Asserts that no request goes outside the site's origin, which also proves the client makes no GitHub API call at runtime.
- `tests/e2e/budget.spec.ts`: performance budget. Reads `dist/` for gzipped sizes: initial entry JS at most 60 kB and the lazily loaded Three.js chunk at most 170 kB. Frame loop: counts `requestAnimationFrame` callbacks over 2 seconds on software WebGL and requires at least 10 per second. This is a lower bound on a CPU rasterizer, not a measurement on integrated graphics, and the README says so.
- `tests/unit/links.test.ts`: every relative link in the Markdown docs resolves; every artifact link is `https`.
- Save restore and content link integrity are covered by existing `progress.spec.ts`, `save.test.ts`, `content.test.ts`, and `contribution.test.ts`.

## Verified defect to fix

At 1280x720 the Rev C table's last row is clipped in the reading pane until scrolled (seen in a developer screenshot from the Episode 000 WorkUnit). Remove the blank line before the table in both manuals. A new assertion in `journey.spec.ts` checks the last mark row is within the reader's visible box after the fix.

## Documentation (only what exists)

- `README.md`: what it is, how to play (the Pages URL), no account or server, how to develop, spoiler warning for the design doc, known limitations.
- `docs/architecture.md`: modules and the engine/content boundary, as they are in `src/`.
- `docs/game-design.md`: add the service code, FORGE, and the community thread as built.
- `docs/swarmos.md`: how to claim and complete a WorkUnit here, the root-issue-and-sub-issue Epic on a personal repo (supernovae/SwarmOS#369), and why browser tests run in CI (supernovae/SwarmOS#370).
- `docs/roadmap.md`: future expansion, and first contribution missions. No promises with dates.
- `AGENTS.md`: a repository section with the module map, the sandbox lessons, and a pointer to the design doc.

## Post-merge

After merge, the coordinator runs the deployed-site verification and records the result on the parent issue. It is not a sandbox validation gate.

## Out of scope

New features. Code changes other than the defect above and the test hook.

# Test plan

Local commands: `npx vitest run tests/unit/links.test.ts`, `npm run lint`. Browser evidence comes from the PR's `Browser tests` workflow, which runs `tests/e2e/{journey,startup,budget}.spec.ts`. Developer and tester may complete with browser evidence pending CI.

| Acceptance criterion | Verification | Owner |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Browser tests play from the opening to the post-episode map in normal and reduced-motion configurations | `journey.spec.ts`, both configurations | CI |
| Tests cover broken content links, save restore and application startup; a performance budget for bundle and frame loop is checked | `links.test.ts`, `contribution.test.ts`, `progress.spec.ts`, `startup.spec.ts`, `budget.spec.ts`. Tester inspects the thresholds and confirms the README states the limitation. | Developer; CI |
| README, architecture, content-authoring, game-design, swarmos, roadmap and AGENTS are present and accurate | `links.test.ts` asserts presence and resolving links. Tester reads each against the source tree, flagging anything aspirational. | Developer; tester inspects |
| The deployed URL loads and is verified after merge, with known limitations listed | Post-merge, coordinator: `curl` returns 200, then `SIGNAL_LOST_LIVE=1 npx playwright test journey`. Result is recorded on issue #1. Limitations are in `README.md`. | Coordinator, post-merge |

## Roles

- **Developer:** runs the local commands above.
- **Tester:** independently inspects source and documents against the criteria, reuses applicable passing results, repeats only for relevant changes, failures, or unresolved coverage.
- **Coordinator:** alone runs the complete required policy and the post-merge check.

VERDICT: CHANGES_REQUESTED

## Contract audit

| Area | Assessment | Evidence / required revision |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Opening through post-episode map, both motion settings | Covered in design | Proposed journey uses the real UI and both motion settings; explicitly retain assertions for the post-episode map, beyond the ending checked by the existing `tests/e2e/helpers.ts`. |
| Broken links, save restore, startup | Covered | Existing `tests/unit/content.test.ts` checks unresolved references; `contribution.test.ts` validates repository content and FORGE form targets; `tests/e2e/progress.spec.ts` covers reload and corrupt saves. Proposed startup and Markdown-link tests fill the remaining areas. |
| Bundle and frame-loop budgets | Revision required | Bundle thresholds are explicit, but the frame measurement must establish that actual game rendering is active (R2). |
| Seven required documents accurate | Covered | All seven are assigned verification in TEST_PLAN.md, including the existing content-authoring guide. New documentation must be checked against source; planned features belong only in the roadmap. |
| Deployed URL after merge and limitations | Covered as deferred work | `playwright.config.ts` specifies the Pages URL; proposed live fixture mode disables interception. Coordinator owns post-deployment verification and recording results; this remains pending until deployment succeeds. |
| Only verified defect fixes | Revision required | Claimed clipping defect cites an unavailable screenshot, without a reproducible baseline (R1). |
| Boundaries, dependencies, protected files | Acceptable | WorkUnit explicitly permits harness changes. AGENTS.md documentation changes are scoped; no dependencies or workflow changes are proposed. Browser execution stays in CI, consistent with sandbox restrictions. |

## Required revisions

1. **R1 — Verify the proposed manual change before authorizing it.** PLAN.md calls clipping a verified defect based on a developer screenshot from another WorkUnit, but supplies no artifact path or reproducible evidence. REVIEW_EVIDENCE.md repeats the plan and test plan; it contains no screenshot or independent defect report. Scrolling content alone does not establish a defect. Cite accessible evidence and specify baseline reproduction, expected behaviour, and the exact affected files (`content/archives/manual-rev-a.json` and `content/archives/manual-rev-c.json`). Alternatively, make the edit conditional on a failing regression assertion against the unchanged baseline in browser CI, or remove it. Preserve a failing-before/passing-after result if a fix is made. Do not block sandbox implementation on running Chromium locally.

2. **R2 — Make the frame budget measure the application loop.** Counting generic requestAnimationFrame callbacks can pass while the renderer failed to load, fell back to a static view, or stopped scheduling. `src/render/host.ts` permits load failure; `src/render/loop.ts` intentionally stops scheduling for reduced motion or hidden documents; actual rendering happens in `src/render/environment.ts`. Specify how the test confirms successful WebGL initialization, normal motion and visibility, then measures callbacks belonging to the active application renderer (or completed render frames), rather than a test-owned animation loop. Require failure when that renderer stops. Identify the exact file and purpose of the currently unspecified “test hook,” or use browser-side instrumentation without a production hook. Retain the stated software-rendering limitation and explicit threshold.

## Handoff and validation evidence

Reviewed SYSTEM_PROMPT.md and WORKUNIT.md first, then PLAN.md, TEST_PLAN.md and REVIEW_EVIDENCE.md. Verified the cited fixture, helper, Playwright configuration, Pages and Browser tests workflows, render lifecycle, existing content/reference and save/restore tests, package scripts, and documentation inventory through source inspection. No implementation tests were run for this plan-only review.

Developer owns focused link tests and lint; tester independently inspects documentation, threshold validity, source coverage and applicable results. Browser tests depend on the production build (`tests/e2e/global-setup.ts`) and execute in the existing Browser tests workflow. Pending browser evidence must be resolved before merge. Coordinator alone runs the complete trusted-base policy and, after successful Pages deployment, checks the live URL and both journey configurations with interception disabled, recording results and known limitations. These advisory review findings do not replace coordinator validation or change the configured `none` plan gate.
